## TemplateEngine.\_processSwitchBlocks() method

Transforms `<switch>` blocks into JavaScript switch statement expressions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processSwitchBlocks(template: string): string;
```

**Returns:**

string

The template with `<switch>` blocks converted to executable switch expressions

## Remarks

This internal method converts `<switch>` blocks with `<case>` and `<default>` sub-blocks into self-invoking JavaScript switch expressions. The `value` attribute specifies which data key to switch on. Case values can be comma-separated for multiple matches.

## Example


```typescript
const template = `
  <switch value="status">
    <case is="active">Active status</case>
    <case is="pending">Pending status</case>
    <default>Unknown status</default>
  </switch>
`;
const processed = TemplateEngine._processSwitchBlocks(template);
// Result: '${(() => { switch((data && data["status"])) { case "active": return `Active status`; ... } })()}'
```
